titleEn: How Long Does a Bathroom Renovation Take in Metro Vancouver? Real 2026 Timelines
titleZh: 温哥华浴室翻新需要多长时间？2026年真实工期解析
contentEn:
A standard three-piece bathroom renovation in Metro Vancouver takes 12 to 18 working days. A master bath with curbless shower and heated floors runs 3 to 5 weeks. These are real numbers from Reno Stars projects in Richmond, North Vancouver, Burnaby, Delta, and Coquitlam in 2026.

Phase-by-Phase Timeline

Phase 1: Demo — Days 1-3

Day 1 covers dust barriers and photo documentation. Single-bathroom demo takes 1 day; dual-bathroom demo takes 2. In pre-1990 homes, asbestos testing must clear before demo — budget 3-5 business days for older Metro Vancouver buildings.

Phase 2: Rough-In Plumbing and Electrical — Days 3-6

Standard layout rough-in takes 2-3 days. Curbless (zero-threshold) shower rough-in takes 3-4 days due to preslope and membrane work. Condo electrical panel work requires utility notification — budget 2-5 days in Strata buildings.

Phase 3: Tiling — Days 6-13

Tiling is the longest phase. Straight-lay 12x24 porcelain: 4-5 days. Herringbone or hexagon mosaic: 5-7 days. Natural stone: add 2-4 cure days. Curbless shower floor: 5-7 days. Grout cure: 24-48 hours before sealing.

Phase 4: Vanity and Countertops — Days 13-17

Quartz countertop lead time: 5-10 business days from measure to install. Natural stone: 10-15 business days. Stock or semi-custom vanity: 2-3 weeks. Custom millwork: 4-6 weeks.

Phase 5: Fixtures and Final Clean — Days 17-20

Toilet, faucet, shower fixtures, mirror, hardware, and final punch-list walkthrough. 2-3 days for single bathroom; 3-4 days for dual.

Real Project Timelines (2026)

  • Richmond hallway bathroom refresh: 10 working days
  • Richmond ensuite, curbless shower, heated floor: 17 working days
  • North Vancouver, herringbone tile, brushed gold fixtures: 19 working days
  • Delta townhouse dual-bathroom (simultaneous): 22 working days
  • Burnaby whole-house, three bathrooms in sequence: 8 weeks

Common Delays

  • Special-order materials: Custom glass or imported mosaic: 2-4 week lead time. Reno Stars orders during demo week.
  • Strata approval: 2-6 weeks in most condo buildings. Reno Stars submits in parallel with demo.
  • Asbestos (pre-1990): 5-10 business days for testing and abatement.
  • Unforeseen damage: Rotted subfloor or failed shower pan found at demo: 1-3 extra days.

How to Stay on Schedule

  1. Select tile before demo begins — it must be on site by day 1 of tiling.
  2. Confirm vanity dimensions by day 3 — ordered day 3 arrives week 3; ordered day 10 arrives week 4.
  3. Submit Strata approval during demo week — approval and demo run in parallel.

FAQ

How long does a small bathroom renovation take in Vancouver?

A compact condo bathroom — new tile floor, new toilet, wall-hung vanity, standard shower — takes 10-14 working days. Custom glass adds 2-3 weeks lead time before install.

How long does a master bathroom renovation take?

Master bath with curbless shower, heated floor, double vanity, freestanding tub: 3-5 weeks. Curbless shower adds 2-3 days to rough-in. Standard step-in shower master bath: 2.5-3.5 weeks.

Can a bathroom renovation be done in one week?

No. Even a cosmetic-only refresh requires 5-7 working days. Rough-in inspections alone take 1-2 days to schedule in Metro Vancouver.

Does Reno Stars do two bathrooms at once?

Yes. A Delta dual-bathroom project completed both bathrooms in 22 working days in early 2026. Two simultaneous standard bathrooms typically complete in 3-4 weeks.

What is the longest phase in a bathroom renovation?

Tiling. Straight-lay porcelain takes 4-5 days. Herringbone or mosaic takes 5-7 days. Followed by 2-3 grout cure days before the finish phase.

contentZh:
大温哥华标准三件套浴室翻新通常需要12至18个工作日。配备无障碍淋浴间和地暖的主卧浴室需要3至5周。这些数字来自Reno Stars于2026年在列治文、北温哥华、本拿比、Delta和高贵林完成的项目实绩。

各阶段详细工期

第一阶段：拆除 — 第1-3天

第一天进行防尘隔断和现场拍照记录。单间浴室拆除需1天；双浴室需2天。1990年前建成的房屋须先进行石棉检测并通过才能拆除——较老的大温哥华建筑需要额外预算3至5个工作日。

第二阶段：管道和电气粗装 — 第3-6天

标准布局粗装需2-3天。无障碍（零门槛）淋浴间粗装因找坡和防水层工艺需3-4天。公寓配电箱工程须通知水电局——分层物业需额外预算2至5天。

第三阶段：瓷砖铺贴 — 第6-13天

瓷砖铺贴是最耗时的阶段。直线铺贴12x24陶瓷砖：4-5天。鱼骨砖或六角马赛克：5-7天。天然石材：密封前额外养护2-4天。无障碍淋浴间地面：5-7天。填缝后须养护24-48小时方可密封。

第四阶段：浴室柜和台面 — 第13-17天

石英石台面从测量到安装备货时间：5-10个工作日。天然石材：10-15个工作日。库存或半定制浴室柜：2-3周。定制木制品：4-6周。

第五阶段：五金和最终保洁 — 第17-20天

坐厕、水龙头、淋浴五金、镜子、配件和整改清单验收。单间浴室需2-3天；双浴室需3-4天。

真实项目工期（2026年）

  • 列治文走廊浴室翻新：10个工作日
  • 列治文主卧套间，无障碍淋浴间，地暖：17个工作日
  • 北温哥华，鱼骨砖淋浴墙，黄铜色五金：19个工作日
  • Delta联排别墅双浴室（同步施工）：22个工作日
  • 本拿比全屋翻新含三间浴室：8周

常见延误原因

  • 定制品材料未到现场：定制玻璃或进口马赛克备货需2-4周。Reno Stars在拆除周期间下单。
  • 分层物业审批：大多数公寓建筑审批需2-6周。Reno Stars与拆除并行提交审批材料。
  • 石棉（1990年前建筑)：检测和治理需5-10个工作日。
  • 意外损坏：拆除时发现腐烂底板或损坏淋浴盘：增加1-3天。

如何确保按时完成

  1. 拆除开始前选好瓷砖——瓷砖须在铺贴第一天到场。
  2. 第三天前确认浴室柜尺寸——第三天订购第三周到货；第十天订购则第四周到货。
  3. 拆除周期间同步提交分层审批——审批与拆除并行推进。

常见问题

温哥华小浴室翻新需要多长时间？

温哥华紧凑型公寓浴室——新地砖、新坐厕，壁挂式浴室柜、标准淋浴间——从拆除到最终保洁需10-14个工作日。定制玻璃隔断安装前需额外2-3周备货时间。

大温哥华主卧浴室翻新需要多长时间？

配备无障碍淋浴间、地暖，双台面浴室柜和独立式浴缸的主卧浴室需3-5周。无障碍淋浴间在粗装阶段增加2-3天。标准步入式淋浴主卧浴室：2.5-3.5周。

浴室翻新能在一周内完成吗？

不能。即使最快的表面翻新也需要至少5-7个工作日。粗装检查仅预约在大温哥华城市就需1-2天。

Reno Stars可以同时翻新两间浴室吗？

可以。Reno Stars于2026年初在Delta完成的双浴室项目，两间共用了22个工作日。两间同步施工的标准浴室通常在3-4周内完成。

浴室翻新中最耗时的阶段是什么？

瓷砖铺贴。直线铺贴陶瓷砖需4-5天。鱼骨砖或马赛克需5-7天。之后还需2-3天填缝养护才能进入收尾阶段。
